per_object_cap.stated: A single object is limited to 5 TB; one request uploads at most 5 GB and larger objects need multipart upload; in the cold and ice classes an object smaller than 128 KB is billed as 128 KB
per_object_cap.notes: the 5 TB object cap and the 5 GB per-request limit are tenant limits that cannot be raised; the storage volume itself is unlimited by default; a bucket created in the console can be given a maximum volume, buckets created through the API are unlimited in volume

retention.stated: Storage is billed on the largest volume held during each hour, at the tariff of the class the object is in

identity_cost.detail: Participation is limited to individuals, sole traders and legal entities registered in Russia. identity_cost.detail: card: the RUB 4,000 grant is 'credited for the first bank card attached and only for a card never previously attached to any Cloud.ru account', so a card is required to receive it, while 'paid consumption is available without the grant'. No authorisation or hold amount is stated, and whether debit or prepaid is accepted is not stated: unknown. The record's notes add a second gate the evidence rows do not carry: the campaign rules approved 2026-06-30 require the account to be registered in the Russian Federation.

evidence.proved: the starter grant page states, in Russian, that the Test Evolution starter grant has a face value of 4,000 bonuses, that the bonuses are available for 60 days after they are credited, that the grant is credited for the first bank card attached and only for a card never previously attached to any Cloud.ru account, and that the exclusions include Evolution Compute with GPUs, Evolution ML Inference and Foundation Models
the page also states that a user who does not receive the grant on those conditions can sign in through Sber ID or T-ID to check eligibility, and that paid consumption is available without the grant

record.notes: The Russian free lane is thin and shrinking: Yandex withdrew its grant, Selectel states in its own FAQ that cloud servers have no free test, Timeweb Cloud has no fixed-length trial, and cloud.ru's RUB 4,000 is the largest general-purpose entry found. VK Cloud's RUB 2,000,000 startup grant needs a legal entity and is a discount schedule rather than credit. The campaign rules approved on 2026-06-30 require the account to be registered in the Russian Federation, and the 2 vCPU / 4 GiB free VM is closed to accounts registered after 2026-06-30. What survives is 25 vCPU-hours a month of Container Apps and the object-storage egress allowance.

record.tooling: S3-compatible; endpoint class obs.ru-moscow-1.hc.sbercloud.ru answered 403 to an anonymous list (expected for a private bucket API). rclone `s3`, aws-cli.
record.chaining: Per-GB, so 5 TB and 20 TB share the rate.
record.limits_note: The ₽1.1346/GB rate is only for the single-zone class; multi-zone and the cold classes are separately priced and were not captured. Enterprise onboarding (legal entity or individual with Russian card).
record.reliability_note: Cloud.ru is the rebranded SberCloud and is the largest non-hyperscaler Russian cloud; the technical reliability is not in question. The commercial blocker is that tariff documents are PDFs behind a Russian-language portal, prices are VAT-inclusive for Russian entities, and the egress annex could not be read. So the total cost of ownership is unknown even though the storage line is the cheapest Russian object rate found.
